      Key Responsibilities:

      • Lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs.
      • Own backend architecture, system design, and technical decisions.
      • Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code.
      • Build and optimize REST APIs/microservices and database solutions.
      • Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
      • Work closely with Product, Frontend, DevOps, and other teams.
      • Conduct code reviews and establish engineering best practices.
      • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
      • Troubleshoot production issues and drive root-cause resolution.

      Requirements:

      • 8+ years of backend development experience.
      • Strong proficiency in Node.js backend technology.
      • Strong understanding of DSA, OOP, databases, APIs, and system design.
      • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases.
      • Hands-on experience with microservices and distributed systems.
      • Good understanding of AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, and CI/CD.
      • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
      • Prior experience leading projects or mentoring engineers.

      Good to Have:

      Experience handling high-scale systems and large data volumes.

      Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, or similar technologies.

      Experience owning backend architecture from 0→1.

      • Seniority level

        Mid-Senior level

      • Employment type

        Full-time

      • Industries

        Technology, Information and Internet
